description: Pinned, reproducible build toolchain for the macOS-compatible (Darwin-based) shape. Built on a LINUX cross-build host; the SLeeLa OS Creator provisions this environment and runs macos/build-shape.sh to compile a chosen path into its artifact. No Apple macOS image, Apple binaries, Apple SDK, or Apple developer account is used (XNU is public APSL-2.0 source).

hostBase.rationale: Linux cross-build host matching the Ubuntu 24.04.4 base the OS Creator ships for linux/. PureDarwin/Darling and the GNUstep stack cross-build here; PureDarwin also offers a Nix flake for a fully pinned toolchain.

darwin-os.buildEntry: cmake -G Ninja -B build && ninja -C build image

requires.notes: PureDarwin (Path 1b) stages the XNU kernel + Darwin userland and emits a bootable image. For a fully pinned build, PureDarwin's flake.nix/build.nix provide a reproducible toolchain ('nix build'). XNU (macos/os-core/xnu, buildEntry 'make') is driven through PureDarwin on a Linux host so companion headers/tools stage in the right order.

Build in order (runtime -> make -> base -> corebase -> gui -> back); after gnustep-make, source GNUstep.sh. swift-corelibs-foundation additionally needs a Swift toolchain (swift/swiftc) and is optional.
Upstream Darling pulls the bulk Darwin sources via git submodules; this warehouse carries the top-level tree. A full build initializes submodules from the upstream remote first.

orchestrator.emits: darwin-os -> puredarwin.iso; frameworks -> installed GNUstep prefix; darwin-runtime -> installed Darling prefix.
